title: Floral Digital Papers Seamless Pattern
author: Rusho Designs
description:
Floral Digital Papers, Pastel Flowers Digital Paper, Instant Download File, Flower Background, Spring Meadow, Seamless Pattern
Add a soft floral touch to your creative projects with these Floral Digital Papers. Featuring beautiful pastel flowers in a seamless repeating pattern, this high-resolution digital paper is perfect for scrapbooking, stationery, invitations, journals, gift wrap, packaging, and many other creative projects.

1 ZIP file

High-resolution PNG file
Size: 12 x 12 inches
Resolution: 300 DPI
Perfect For:
Scrapbooking
Journals and planners
Greeting cards
Invitations
Stationery
Gift wrap
Packaging
DIY crafts
Printable projects
Digital backgrounds
Creative designs
